headline: Qualcomm and Arm await a jury verdict this week, ahead of Tesla, IBM and Lam Research on Oct 21. Software led Friday as Palantir and Okta hit 52-week highs and Snowflake broke out, while Arm and Intel slid into oversold territory

Wed Oct 14: Micron ex-dividend; Lam pays its $0.33 dividend. Around Oct 16: Google ad-tech proposed judgments due (my count). Mon Oct 19: Tutanota's mini-tender for CrowdStrike shares expires. Oct 28: Microsoft (confirmed), Alphabet and Meta (est.). Oct 29: Intel and Sandisk (confirmed), Amazon (est.). Nov 2: Apple and Palantir (est.). Nov 3: AMD and Astera (confirmed). Nov 4: Arm (confirmed) and Qualcomm (est.). Nov 5: MP Materials (confirmed). Chart picture: after Oct 8's AI selloff on OpenAI's revenue disclosure, Friday rotated into software.
